caption: Lemsterpoort, Sloten
composition: Yellow-brick water gate of 1821, stage mill on the bastion beside it · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Lemsterpoort is a single yellow-brick water gate of 1821, a high basket-handle arch over the Diep, with a smaller pedestrian opening beside the water. An octagonal stage mill stands on the bastion next to the gate. The land gates are gone. It is not the two-tower water gate at Sneek. It is partly cloudy, about 10.2°C, with wind near 3.6 km/h and cloud cover about 74%.
